component.name: Al Quran
component.summary: Read the Holy Quran with tafsir, audio, and prayer times

description.p: Al Quran is a comprehensive companion for reading the Holy Quran, listening to recitations, and tracking daily prayer times.

ul.li: Multiple Quran scripts including Uthmani, Indopak, and Tajweed color coding
Offline translations, tafsirs, and word-by-word analysis across dozens of languages
Synchronized ayah and word-by-word audio recitation with sleep timer
Global prayer time calculations, Qibla direction, and daily reading plans

screenshot.caption: Quran Reader with Arabic script, translation, and word-by-word analysis
Main Quran dashboard with Surah, Juz, Page, Hizb, and Ruku navigation
Prayer times schedule, live countdown, and Hijri calendar
Synchronized Quran audio player with reciter selection

description.p: Desktop UI improvements, Flutter 3.50.1 update, and Linux prayer settings stability fixes.
